product_overview: Plataforma integral para la gestión de gimnasios que centraliza clientes, planes, pagos y genera recomendaciones de entrenamiento y nutrición automáticamente. Provee una interfaz moderna y segura con soporte para autenticación vía Supabase y navegación rápida.
core_goals: Centralizar la gestión de socios, planes y transacciones en un único sistema.
Automatizar la generación de planes nutricionales y rutinas básicas a partir de métricas físicas.
Ofrecer una experiencia de usuario rápida y consistente (KBar, modo oscuro/claro).
Proveer visibilidad financiera y seguimiento de ingresos por cliente.
Garantizar seguridad y sesiones robustas mediante Supabase Auth y SSR.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Autenticación de usuarios mediante email/password y Google OAuth usando Supabase; acceso controlado a rutas protegidas.
user_flows: Navigate to /iniciar-sesion -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click "Iniciar Sesión" button -> Redirect to /panel -> See dashboard summary
Navigate to /iniciar-sesion -> Click "Continuar con Google" button -> Complete Google OAuth flow -> Redirect to /panel -> See dashboard summary

Navigate to /iniciar-sesion -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field (incorrect) -> Click "Iniciar Sesión" button -> See error message "Credenciales inválidas" -> Remain on /iniciar-sesion
Navigate to /iniciar-sesion -> Click "Continuar con Google" button -> Deny OAuth consent -> See error message about authentication failure -> Remain on /iniciar-sesion

features.name: Dashboard & Summary
features.description: Vista principal con métricas diarias, accesos rápidos y enlaces a secciones administrativas (resumen estadístico y panel principal).
user_flows: Navigate to /panel -> See quick metrics and recent activity cards -> Click Resumen nav item -> Navigate to /panel/resumen -> See charts and financial summary
Navigate to /panel/resumen -> Loading state appears -> Data loads successfully -> See charts with totals and trends
Navigate to /panel -> Not authenticated -> Redirect to /iniciar-sesion -> See message indicating login required
Navigate to /panel/resumen -> Loading state appears -> API error occurs -> See error placeholder with retry action

features.name: Client Management
features.description: Listado, búsqueda, creación y edición de perfiles de clientes con métricas físicas, estado de membresía y historial de evaluaciones.
user_flows: Navigate to /panel/clientes -> View list of clients -> Search for clients -> Click client row -> See client profile with personal and physical data
Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click Add New Client -> Fill required form fields -> Click Save -> See new client in list
Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click Add New Client -> Fill incomplete form (missing required fields) -> Click Save -> See validation errors on specific fields -> Remain on form
Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click client row -> Click Edit -> Update contact field -> Click Save -> See client details updated in profile

features.name: Plans & Subscriptions
features.description: Configuración y gestión de planes de membresía, duraciones y precios; soporte para crear suscripciones y controlar solapamientos de períodos.
user_flows: Navigate to /panel/planes -> See list of plans -> Click Create Plan -> Fill name, price and duration -> Click Save -> See new plan in list
Navigate to /panel/planes -> Click a plan -> Click Edit -> Change price -> Click Save -> See updated plan in list
Navigate to /panel/planes -> Click Create Plan -> Fill fields with invalid price (negative) -> Click Save -> See validation error for price -> Remain on create form
Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Open client subscription modal -> Select plan and start/end dates -> Click Save Subscription -> Save succeeds and subscription appears on client profile

Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Open client subscription modal -> Select start date that overlaps existing subscription -> Click Save Subscription -> See error about overlapping subscription -> Prevent save

features.name: Payments & Financial Tracking
features.description: Registro de transacciones por suscripción, soporte para múltiples métodos de pago y un historial financiero consultable desde el panel de pagos.
user_flows: Navigate to /panel/pagos -> See payments list and totals -> Click Record Payment -> Fill amount and select method (Efectivo/Card/Transfer) -> Click Save -> See new transaction in list
Navigate to /panel/pagos -> Use filters to view date range -> See filtered transactions and updated totals
Navigate to /panel/pagos -> Click Record Payment -> Leave amount empty -> Click Save -> See validation error for amount -> Remain on payment form
Navigate to /panel/pagos -> Click a transaction -> See transaction details with associated client and subscription

features.name: Fitness Logic Engine (Nutrición y Rutinas)
features.description: Motor que calcula recomendaciones de calorías, distribución de macronutrientes y genera rutinas básicas a partir de edad, género, peso y nivel de actividad.
user_flows: Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click client row -> Click "Agregar Evaluación Física" -> Fill age, gender, weight, height and activity level -> Click Generate Plan -> See generated daily calories, water goal and macronutrient breakdown
Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click client row -> Click "Generar Rutina" -> Select objective and intensity -> Click Generate -> See routine blocks and suggested exercises

Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click client row -> Click "Agregar Evaluación Física" -> Leave required metric empty -> Click Generate Plan -> See validation error for missing metrics -> Remain on evaluation form
Navigate to /panel/clientes -> Click client row -> Click "Generate Plan" -> Server/process error occurs -> See friendly error with retry option

features.name: Command Bar (KBar) & Theme
features.description: Atajo de teclado y paleta de comandos para navegar rápidamente entre secciones; soporte nativo de modo oscuro/claro.
user_flows: On any page -> Press Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K) -> See KBar open -> Type "Clientes" -> Press Enter -> Navigate to /panel/clientes
On any page -> Press Cmd+K -> See KBar open -> Type unknown command -> See no-results state with help suggestions
On any page (desktop) -> Toggle theme control -> Switch to Dark Mode -> See UI switch to dark theme immediately
On mobile -> Attempt to use Cmd+K -> See hint that keyboard shortcut is not available on touch devices -> Open command palette button and tap to open

features.description: Login with email and password or Google OAuth using Supabase
